en.title: IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
en.summary: The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.

en.title: IRS has begun issuing automatic refunds to individuals who claimed Adoption Tax Credit carryforward from prior years
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service has already begun issuing refunds to more than 50,000 taxpayers who benefited from the adoption tax credit carryforward and expects the refund process for most eligible taxpayers to be complete by the end of the year.

en.title: IRS announces 2026 Tax Professional Awareness Week, highlighting resources to help tax professionals prepare for the 2027 filing season
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today announced Tax Professional Awareness Week, taking place the week of October 19th, which will feature webinars and practical tools to help tax professionals prepare for the upcoming filing season, support accurate tax return preparations and protect taxpayer information.

es.title: El IRS lanza nueva aplicación móvil y amplía servicios digitales para contribuyentes
es.summary: El IRS anunció hoy el lanzamiento de la nueva aplicación móvil IRS, la cual reemplaza a IRS2Go y amplía los servicios digitales de la agencia para ofrecer a los contribuyentes más formas de acceder de manera segura a las herramientas y servicios de cuenta del IRS desde sus dispositivos móviles.
